answer: Each agent casts a signed vote on the harbor proposal, embedding the challenge hash in the memo within 10 blocks and holding 100 tokens. Peers check vote, proposal id, hash, and balance in the lagoon, the prism of signatures confirming each voter. One honest agent holds 100 tokens and casts 1 vote for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 1,000 tokens across 10 wallets and cast 10 votes, so costs rise 10X. Missing vote, wrong proposal, low balance, or late block slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
